messages:
incident-bot: PAGER triggered (HIGH) — 5xx error-rate spike on inference-gateway-usw2. PD incident: INC-7234. Alert: 5xx > 4% for 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-7234 :rotating_light:
alice_nguyen: acked. I'm on it, spinning up basic checks now.
bob_mckee: thanks alice. quick ask — is this multi-az or only usw2-a?
alice_nguyen: looks concentrated in usw2-a per initial metrics. hitting the gateway logs now.
carol_ops: seeing a sudden surge of POST /v1/generate from a handful of clients — spike from 3 IPs in same ASN. Could be retry storm.
dave_prod: any client IDs? if it's a single customer we should contact CSM.
carol_ops: client ids: client-42, client-99, client-rtx. rate ~1200 rps each.
elena_csm: I'm on standby — if it's a paying customer I'll reach out after we confirm impact.
alice_nguyen: quick mitigation: applying aggressive rate-limit for those client IDs on the gateway (scope: 60s window, max 200 req/min). running: `curl -X POST https://gateway-api/rl/update -d '{"clients":["client-42","client-99","client-rtx"],"limit":200}'`
bob_mckee: good. also flipping to fallback model pool for high-latency requests to reduce retries: `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/gateway FALLBACK_POOL=true` — rolling 3 pods.
incident-bot: PD note: alice_nguyen assigned. Escalation timer paused.
alice_nguyen: rate-limits applied — 5xx rate dropped from 4.5% -> 1.1% in the last 60s. observed a backlog in upstream KV cache errors that lined up with spike.
dave_prod: KV cache evictions at the same window — looks like prefix cache thrash from those heavy repeating prompts. evict thresholds bumped to reduce churn.
elena_csm: I'll DM client-42 contact now and flag we're throttling while we investigate.
carol_ops: continuing to monitor. if 5xx < 0.5% for 5m we can remove temporary limits.
bob_mckee: documenting follow-ups: 1) alert rule to add ASN filtering, 2) tune KV cache eviction policy for pattern X, 3) run a small replay against staging to reproduce.
alice_nguyen: agreed. I'll stay until stabilization then handoff to on-call rotation in 30m. prepping a short incident summary for postmortem.
incident-bot: PD update: INC-7234 status -> acknowledged. Next update scheduled +15m. :white_check_mark:
carol_ops: note for handoff — customer impact: degraded generation latency and increased 502s for 0.6% of global requests during peak window; top-affected tenant: client-42.
alice_nguyen: final check: 5xx now 0.3% over last 2m, latency back to normal p50/p95. I'll mark stable and handoff.
bob_mckee: thanks team. good rapid containment. add CSM follow-up and ops action items to the incident doc.
elena_csm: I have the client on standby, will send summary + next steps.
alice_nguyen: handing off to bob_mckee for overnight watch. signing off at 6790012480. :wave:
